description: This file defines the AlertRecipient class in the OpenMRS platform, representing a recipient of an alert with associated metadata such as read status and timestamps. It is used for notification management within the system.

classes.name: AlertRecipient
classes.description: Represents a recipient of an alert in the notification system, including read status and associated alert and user details.

methods.name: getDateChanged
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the alert was last changed.

methods.name: setDateChanged
methods.description: Sets the timestamp when the alert was last changed.

methods.name: isAlertRead
methods.description: Checks whether the alert has been marked as read.

methods.name: getAlertRead
methods.description: Returns whether the alert has been read (alias for isAlertRead).

methods.name: setAlertRead
methods.description: Sets the read status of the alert.

methods.name: getRecipient
methods.description: Returns the User object representing the recipient.

methods.name: setRecipient
methods.description: Sets the User object as the recipient and updates recipientId.
